source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
A datasheet’s keywords, in bold capitals, are split into faction keywords and the rest; both work the same way, except that faction keywords also decide which models your army can include.

When checking keywords:

- A unit has every keyword of all its models, so a rule for a unit that has a keyword applies if at least 1 of its models has it.
- A model has only its own keywords, so a rule for models with a keyword affects only those models, even in a mixed unit.
- A rule for ‘non-KEYWORD’ models or units applies only to those without that keyword.
- Attacks target units, not models.
- Keywords separated by commas, slashes or ‘or’ mean any one of them; adjacent keywords, such as **AELDARI** **GUARDIANS**, mean all of them.
- Older rules that give keywords without saying model or unit, such as **MONSTER/VEHICLE** or **TRANSPORT**, mean units.
- A keyword works the same in singular or plural.
